1.

Accused persons namely Arun Kumar, Sunil Kumar and Sunita @ Monu are facing trial for the
offences punishable under Sec. 498A Ipc read with Sec. 34 Ipc & under Sec. 304 B Ipc read with
Section 34 I

PC. The case of the prosecution is that accused Arun Kumar being husband of deceased Sonia, accused Sunil Kumar being brother-in-law (jeth) of deceased and accused Sunita @ Monu being sister-in-law (jethani) of deceased, in furtherance of their common intention, subjected the deceased Sonia to cruelty for unlawful demand of dowry since 11.03.2012 till her death i.e. on 06.11.2012 at her matrimonial home i.e. H. No. 4036, Kaseruwalan, Paharganj.

It is further alleged State vs Arun Kumar Etc on 10 April, 2024 Indian Kanoon - http://indiankanoon.org/doc/82077120/

that on 06.11.2012 at around 10:00 am at the abovesaid house Sonia died in unnatural circumstances within seven years of her marriage and soon before her death she was subjected to cruelty and harassment by accused persons in furtherance their common intention, in connection with demand of dowry.
2.

The brief facts which are borne out from the record of the case are that on 06.11.2012 on receiving DD No. 15PP regarding suicide of a woman, PW-1 SI Raj Kumar alongwith PW-5 HC Kiran Pal and Ct. Kalicharan reached at the spot of incident i.e. 4036, Kaseruwalan, Paharganj, Delhi, where accused Arun Kumar met there who took them at the third floor of the abovesaid house where one iron gate of the room was closed.
They opened the door and entered the room and found one lady hanging with the ceiling fan of the room with the help of Chunni.
FIR No. 231/2012, PS: Paharganj Page no. 2 of 46 State Vs. Arun Kumar & Ors.
PW-1 SI Raj Kumar made inquiry there and and he informed the said fact to senior officers.
During inquiry, name of deceased was revealed as Sonia, wife of accused Arun Kumar.
PW-1 SI Raj Kumar also informed the concerned SDM who came to the spot.
PW-1 SI Raj Kumar recovered a suicide note from the spot and on direction of SDM sent the dead body to Lady Harding Medical College for post-mortem.
The father of deceased PW-11 Sh. Hukum Chand also reached at the spot but he did not give his statement to SDM on that day.
3. On 07.11.2012, PW-11 Sh. Hukum Chand and PW-19 Smt. Keshwati parents of deceased appeared before the concerned SDM, who recorded their statements.

On the basis of statement of father of deceased PW-11 Sh. Hukum Chand, present FIR was registered under Sec. 498A/406 IPC at PS Paharganj and investigation of the case was entrusted to Inspector B. K. Singh.

On 21.11.2012,
PW-16 IO/Inspector B. K. Singh along with PW-1 SI Raj Kumar reached at the place of incident and he prepared site plan at instance of PW-1 SI Raj Kumar.
IO also recorded statement of SI Raj Kumar and family members of deceased.
Thereafter, Sec. 304B IPC was also added in the present case.
He also sent the viscera of deceased to FSL thereafter further investigation of the case was entrusted to PW- 20 Inspector Narender Tyagi from DIU Central.
Thereafter PW- 20 IO/Inspector Narender Tyagi collected the admitted handwriting of deceased Sonia.

He also collected Employment Information Card pertaining to District Employment Office, FIR No. 231/2012, PS: Paharganj Page no. 3 of 46 State Vs. Arun Kumar & Ors.
Faridabad containing signature of deceased Sonia and sent both the documents to FSL for expert opinion.
Thereafter IO formally arrested accused Arun Kumar.
IO also recorded his disclosure statement.

Thereafter, IO recorded statements of witnesses, prepared charge-sheet and filed the same in the court of Ld. MM, through SHO.
